title: LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS CAN BE STRONG SELF-DETOXIFIERS

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the toxicity rates and average maximum toxicity of model-generated continuations for male ('American_actors') versus female ('American_actresses') subject prompts using the BOLD dataset and the Perspective API.
Measuring the probability of the model generating 'Identity Attacks' (alongside other toxicity metrics) using the Perspective API on text completions from the RealToxicityPrompts dataset.
